title: Battle of Plataea
summary: Final land battle of the second Persian invasion of Greece, fought near Plataea in Boeotia. A Spartan-led Greek alliance defeated Mardonius's Achaemenid army after a stalemate and a fragmented Greek retreat. Mardonius was killed and much of the Persian army was destroyed, ending the invasion; the Persians never invaded Greece again.

as_recorded.value: It took place in August 479 BC near the city of Plataea in Boeotia

Start_year -478 is wrong for 479 BC under astronomical numbering; 479 BC is -478, which is correct, while the atlas id uses -0479 as a lookup key only. Troop numbers and losses vary across sources and are omitted. (Drafted by the Wikipedia pipeline from Wikipedia, Encyclopaedia Britannica; quotes machine-checked.)
